title: Swim In Rising Water
description: You are given an n x n integer matrix grid where grid[i][j] represents the elevation at that point. Starting from the top-left, you want to reach the bottom-right. At time t, you can swim in any direction to adjacent cells as long as the elevation of both cells is at most t. Return the minimum time to swim from (0,0) to (n-1,n-1).
